purpose: This form is used for making an offer or invitation to subscribe to securities through private placement under section 42 of the Companies Act, 2013.
who: A company making an offer or invitation to subscribe to securities through private placement
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Obtain previous approval of shareholders by a special resolution for each offer or invitation.
Include the required disclosures in the explanatory statement annexed to the notice for shareholders approval.
Pass a relevant Board resolution where applicable for non-convertible debentures within limits.
checklist: Particulars of the offer including date of passing of Board resolution
Kinds of securities offered and the price at which security is being offered
Basis or justification for the price including premium
Name and address of valuer who performed valuation
Amount which the company intends to raise by way of such securities
Material terms of raising such securities and proposed time schedule
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
